$comment: The QA range (T-1.12; a named world since T-3.02). `generate` lists the pieces world.ts builds for this world from its own numbers — the distance-post grid, the sprint-lane rails and the reference figure — so another world gets none of them unless it asks. `floor` is the open ground the navmesh bake walks (T-3.03): 100 m either way, the same 200 m square the client draws, because the range targets run out to z = 95, well past every box. Static cover: Axis-aligned boxes: x/z are the centre, y is the BOTTOM, w/h/d are full sizes in metres. The distance posts, the sprint-lane rails and the reference figure are generated in world.ts, not listed here. Keep x -4.2..6 clear north of spawn: the firing range runs up x = 2.5 and the six spawn points sit on z = -6 between x = -3.75 and 3.75, so a soldier walking straight up from the leftmost slot (footprint to x = -4.1) and the fan of shots from it to the farthest target (x = -3.2 at the walls) both stay clear. world.test.ts checks every slot against every target. The west doorway is x -9..-7.8.
